use default

let puzzle = [
    "5 3 . . 7 . . . .",
    "6 . . 1 9 5 . . .",
    ". 9 8 . . . . 6 .",
    "8 . . . 6 . . . 3",
    "4 . . 8 . 3 . . 1",
    "7 . . . 2 . . . 6",
    ". 6 . . . . 2 8 .",
    ". . . 4 1 9 . . 5",
    ". . . . 8 . . 7 9"
]

let grid =
    LIST[int](
        puzzle
            |> flat_map(row => row.split([' ']))
            |> map(cell => if cell =~ "." then 0 else int.parse(cell) fi))

allowed(at: int, digit: int) -> bool is
    let row = at / 9
    let column = at % 9
    let box = (row / 3) * 27 + (column / 3) * 3

    for i in 0..9 do
        if grid[row * 9 + i] == digit \/
            grid[i * 9 + column] == digit \/
            grid[box + (i / 3) * 9 + i % 3] == digit
        then
            return false
        fi
    od

    true
si

solve(at: int) -> bool is
    if at == 81 then
        return true
    fi

    if grid[at] != 0 then
        return solve(at + 1)
    fi

    for digit in 1::9 do
        if allowed(at, digit) then
            grid[at] = digit

            if solve(at + 1) then
                return true
            fi
        fi
    od

    grid[at] = 0

    false
si

show() is
    for row in 0..9 do
        if row % 3 == 0 then
            write_line("+-------+-------+-------+")
        fi

        let cells =
            (0..9)
                |> map(column =>
                    let digit = grid[row * 9 + column] in
                    let text = if digit == 0 then "." else "{digit}" fi in
                    if column % 3 == 0 then "| {text}" else text fi)
                |> join(" ")

        write_line("{cells} |")
    od

    write_line("+-------+-------+-------+")
si

write_line("puzzle:")
show()

if solve(0) then
    write_line("")
    write_line("solution:")
    show()
else
    write_line("no solution")
fi
